usedFor: Lofty holds leads, appointments and transactions, and Hastewire receives their wording through “Humanize Text”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Created” in Lofty, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: A new lead is the moment to draft a reply, and the action makes the draft sound natural.

watchOut: “Humanize Text” in Hastewire only rewrites text, so any message to a lead still waits in Needs you for approval.
